Generated Narrative: CodeSystem avpu-scale

This case-sensitive code system https://nshr-uat.sha.go.ke/fhir/CodeSystem/avpu-scale defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
A AlertThe patient is alert and responds spontaneously.
V Responds to voiceThe patient responds when spoken to.
P Responds to painThe patient responds only to painful stimulation.
U UnresponsiveThe patient does not respond to voice or painful stimulation.
unknown UnknownThe patient's responsiveness could not be established.
